title: Northloop Payments Negative Balance Timelines
content:
A Northloop Payments balance that stays below zero is followed on three plan figures: the calendar days a balance may stay negative before the card on file is charged for the deficit, the number of card charge attempts made for one negative balance before it is referred for collection, and the calendar days of continuous negative balance after which the deficit is referred for collection.

| Payout plan | Card charge days | Card charge attempts | Collection referral days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Payments Starter | 14 | 3 | 90 |
| Payments Biweekly | 30 | 3 | 90 |
| Payments Weekly | 30 | 3 | 90 |
| Payments Daily | 30 | 3 | 90 |
| Payments Daily Plus | 30 | 3 | 90 |
| Payments Enterprise | 45 | 3 | 90 |

- **Card charge days** — calendar days a balance may stay negative before the card on file is charged for the deficit: 14 on Payments Starter, 30 on Payments Biweekly, Weekly, Daily and Daily Plus, and 45 on Payments Enterprise.
- **Card charge attempts** — card charge attempts made for one negative balance before it is referred for collection: 3 on every plan.
- **Collection referral days** — calendar days of continuous negative balance after which the deficit is referred for collection: 90 on every plan.

*Hypothetical comparison.* A balance that has been negative for 20 calendar days is past the Payments Starter figure of 14 days but within the 30 days of Payments Weekly and the 45 days of Payments Enterprise.
